notes: Google Places API (New) list prices, USD per 1,000 billable requests, by method and the tier its field mask buys (lib/places-log.js tierForMask). Shared by places-log.js and places_log.py: every call-log line carries est_usd = list price, before free allowances. The free allowance is per SKU per month and per BILLING ACCOUNT, not per project: another project on the same billing account can use it up, after which every call bills at list price. `places-budget audit` (where installed) reconciles these estimates against the billing export. Update from https://developers.google.com/maps/billing-and-pricing/pricing when Google reprices.
